mapper.select:
select ai.id, ai.name, ai.introduction, ai.address_detail, ai.latitude, ai.longitude, ai.phone, ai.is_release, ai.province_id, ai.city_id, ai.district_id, ai.province_name, ai.city_name, ai.district_name, ifnull(tc.cnt,0) as total_room_count, ifnull(tc.cnt,0)-ifnull(cc.cnt,0) as free_room_count
from ( select id, name, introduction, address_detail, latitude, longitude, phone, is_release, province_id, city_id, district_id, province_name, city_name, district_name from apartment_info
is_deleted = 0 and province_id = #{queryVo.provinceId} and city_id = #{queryVo.cityId} and district_id = #{queryVo.districtId}
)ai left join
( select apartment_id, count(*) cnt from room_info where is_deleted = 0 and is_release = 1 group by apartment_id )tc
on ai.id = tc.apartment_id left join
( select apartment_id, count(*) cnt from lease_agreement where is_deleted = 0 and status in (2,5) group by apartment_id )cc
on ai.id = cc.apartment_id
